locator: pp. 536–538, response to McPherson and Perl, expanded truth and indicative conditionals
interpretation: Historical reading of the expressly qualified full-truth discussion, not a blanket denial of every truth-like status or of normative truth. It blocks attribution of the analyst support clause as Gibbard’s indicative-conditional truth semantics: in that clause every point unsupported by the antecedent supports the conditional. The checked MP result remains separate.
